Package neqsim.process.equipment.separator.emulsion

Class DenseEmulsionLayerModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.separator.emulsion.DenseEmulsionLayerModel
public final class DenseEmulsionLayerModel extends Object
Immutable constant-area water-in-oil dense-emulsion-layer model of Zlobin et al. (2026).

Implements the mechanical-equilibrium functions and stochastic interfacial coalescence law in equations (1)-(14), DOI 10.1002/aic.70429. The conserved state is dispersed water volume divided by horizontal interface area, in metres. This is not the total layer height: the layer also contains trapped continuous oil. The fitted microscopic coalescence parameter must be supplied; it is not predicted from the equation of state.

Assumptions are monodisperse droplets, constant properties and horizontal cross-section, immediate mechanical equilibration, and coalescence predominantly with the underlying free-water phase. Initial monolayer formation, wall effects, internal coalescence avalanches, outlet-level control, and industrial crude-oil qualification are outside the model. Empty initialization uses its mathematical continuous limit; the paper's experimental comparisons start after initial layers have formed. Nothing is installed on an equipment or process calculation path by this class.

1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • DenseEmulsionLayerModel

      public DenseEmulsionLayerModel(double gammaNPerM, double deltaRhoKgPerM3, double radiusM, double omegaPerM2Second)
      Creates a model with the paper's monodisperse packing parameters and lambda equal to one.
      Parameters:
      gammaNPerM - oil-water interfacial tension [N/m], strictly positive
      deltaRhoKgPerM3 - water density minus oil density [kg/m3], strictly positive
      radiusM - dispersed-water droplet radius [m], strictly positive; not diameter
      omegaPerM2Second - stochastic coalescence frequency per contact area [1/(m2 s)], nonnegative
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an input or derived scale is invalid or unrepresentable

    • advance

      public double advance(double initialDispersedWaterDepthM, double incomingFluxMPerS, double dtSeconds)
      Advances conserved dispersed-water inventory with a monotone implicit-Euler step.

      Solves x1 + dt qc(x1) = x0 + dt qin. The unique nonnegative solution is bounded by the water budget; cumulative coalesced water is that budget minus x1. The method is first-order accurate and unconditionally positivity preserving. Refine the time step to assess transient accuracy.

      Parameters:
      initialDispersedWaterDepthM - initial dispersed-water volume per interface area [m]
      incomingFluxMPerS - constant incoming dispersed-water flux during this step [m/s]
      dtSeconds - elapsed time [s], nonnegative
      Returns:
      final dispersed-water volume per interface area [m]
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if inputs or their finite-time water budget are unrepresentable
